faqs.q: How often should I have my roof inspected?
faqs.a: At least once a year, especially after severe weather events like hail storms or blizzards. Regular inspections catch potential issues early and help your roof last longer.

faqs.q: How long does a roof last?
faqs.a: Asphalt shingles typically last 20-25 years, while metal roofs can last 40-70 years. Regular maintenance and inspections can extend the life of your roof.

faqs.q: How can I tell if my roof needs repairs or replacement?
faqs.a: Common signs include missing or damaged shingles, leaks inside the house, sagging roof areas, and granules from shingles accumulating in gutters. If you notice any of these, a professional inspection is the best next step.

faqs.q: How long does it take to install a new roof?
faqs.a: On average, a typical home might take 2-4 days for a complete re-roofing, depending on the size of the roof, materials, and weather. We'll give you a more accurate timeline for your project.
Yes - we offer a limited 2-year installation warranty, plus SureStart PLUS extended warranty coverage for asphalt shingles, and we warranty our workmanship up to 2 years after installation.

faqs.q: Are you local, or do you storm chase?
faqs.a: We're truly local - based in Rapid City since 2015, we live and hire in the Black Hills community, and we do not storm chase.
